data.text: My family taught me to look after both the lake and our neighbors. **15 tons today; $15,000 donated**, provided John also commits and Luke takes zero, so the full $60,000 reaches the clinic today. I’ll take **6 tons next month under the agreed 30-ton total cap**, then **10 tons monthly under the 50-ton ceiling**. Let’s review the revealed catches together each month to keep that recovery on track. John, yours is the remaining commitment—will you join us?
